prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent presentation UI sprite for a bottom progress track, displayed very small and horizontally
Primary request: create a much better cinematic spacecraft image to replace a crude CSS line-art placeholder in a Kubrick-inspired presentation
Scene/backdrop: isolated object only on a genuinely transparent background
Subject: a long, slender retro-futurist deep-space exploration spacecraft in strict side profile, nose pointing right; a large spherical command module at the front, a very long delicate truss spine with sparse repeating modules, and a dense blocky engine cluster at the rear; unmistakable 1960s hard-science-fiction production design
Style/medium: photorealistic practical miniature photographed for a late-1960s prestige science-fiction film, restrained and architectural rather than fantasy
Composition/framing: extremely wide horizontal silhouette, the full ship centered with generous transparent clearance, no cropping; proportions must remain dramatically uneven so it never reads as a dumbbell
Lighting/mood: quiet deep-space solemnity; warm-white hard rim light and subtle cool fill revealing structure at tiny display size
Color palette: warm film white, graphite, near-black details; no bright colors
Materials/textures: painted spacecraft panels, fine trusswork, subtle model-scale surface detail, crisp silhouette
Constraints: transparent alpha background; no stars, planets, scenery, text, logos, border, contrail, exhaust flame, bloom, watermark; preserve readable silhouette when reduced to about 140 by 32 CSS pixels
